newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks trade near highs at midday.
newsitem.headline: French stocks trade near highs at midday.

text.p: French shares were trading near an all-time high set earlier in the day, buoyed by the strength of the dollar and technical factors linked to the expiry on Monday of the CAC-40 share options contract.
"Fund managers are taking new positions. It's the reverse of yesterday (when the index fell)," said one trader.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 60.25 points or 2.11 percent at 2,918.61 at 1115 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was up 45.0 points from Monday's close.
Earlier the CAC-40 hit a record level of 2,925.70.
Total turnover on the CAC-40 was was 3.18 billion francs.
